text:
Ana (CS): Heads-up — BlueNest QBR Tue 10am. They showed a 3x embed spike last week and want runway/budget talk. Need: 90d token forecast, projected burst cost, and an enablement checklist for embedding best-practices.
Mike C (FinOps): Got it. I'll pull rolling 90d tokens + CPI. Quick ask — do we have alert thresholds for embedding ops? :thinking:
Ana (CS): Not tuned for embeds specifically. Suggest thresholds: 75% of monthly credit usage + per-route 95th perc token rate. If triggered send proactive nudge + temporary easing of rate limits.
Harper (Enablement): I'll prepare a short enablement play (docs + checklist) for BlueNest devs: batching tips, prefix caching, quantization recommendation. ETA EOD Mon.
Raj (Eng): Can we add a short-term cache gate on the embedding route? I can push a fallback that forces suffix cache TTL=60s for that account. Need a greenlight.
Ana (CS): Please do. BlueNest is sensitive — they hit 3x cost and called it surprising. Also capture their feedback: they want a better 'what-if' cost simulator in Console.
Mike C (FinOps): Attaching quick SQL I ran to preview burn:

```
SELECT date, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost) as cost
FROM usage
WHERE account_id = 'bluenest' AND product='embeddings'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 90;
```

Mike C (FinOps): Preliminary: projected next 30d at current cadence = ~$18k, with 3x embed burst = ~$52k. We should show BlueNest a conservative + optimistic scenario in the QBR.
Eve (Customer): (BlueNest engineer) thanks for the heads up. We have a nightly batch that doubled after last deploy — we're investigating but would love batching guidance.
Harper (Enablement): I'll include a one-slide 'batching + prefix reuse' cheat-sheet and a quick code snippet for the SDK.
Harper (Enablement): snippet:

```
// JS pseudocode
const batched = await client.embeddings.batch([texts], {max_batch_tokens: 4096});
// reuse prefix cache by hashing common preamble
```

Ana (CS): Ops asks: can we set a temporary credit hold if cost > $40k in 7d? That buys time for mitigation.
Raj (Eng): We can. I'll open a short-lived feature flag for account-level spend hold and wire it to alerts. Assigning to @raj — will post deploy note.
Mike C (FinOps): I'll draft the 3-scenario table (baseline / conservative / burst) and a recommended token cushion. Also recommend the customer enable auto-batching in SDK v2.
Ana (CS): Action list:
- Mike: produce 30/60/90d spend scenarios + slide (due Mon noon)
- Harper: enablement one-pager + code samples (EOD Mon)
- Raj: temp cache gate & spend-hold feature flag (PR today)
- Ana: capture BlueNest feedback in qbr notes, ask for compensatory credit ask if needed

Mike C (FinOps): + I will set an ad-hoc budget alert: account=bluenest threshold=$40k/7d; channel=#customer-alerts with @oncall ping.
Ana (CS): Thanks team. BlueNest QBR deck will include actions + a proposed two-week grace credit. I'll loop in sales if they ask for credits. :thumbsup:
qbr-bot: Reminder set — QBR meeting created: Tue 10:00 AM. Attendees: Ana, Mike C, Harper, Raj, BlueNest (Eve)
Eve (Customer): Appreciate it. We'll try to push a hotfix tonight and share results tomorrow.
Raj (Eng): PR merged, will deploy patch to enable prefix-cache TTL=60s for bluenest. Rolling out now. :rocket:
Ana (CS): Update for doc — capture customer's ask for 'cost simulator' as a product ask. Logging as product feedback.
Harper (Enablement): Uploaded enablement one-pager to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/BlueNest/qbr-resources
Mike C (FinOps): Slide deck draft: https://slides.redwood/blueNest-qbr-draft — please review.
Ana (CS): Great. We'll reconvene Mon 9am for final deck scrub. Thanks everyone.
